Capital One National Association reduced its stake in Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL) by 3.1% during the 2nd quarter, according to the company in its most recent 13F filing with the Securities and Exchange Commission. The firm owned 234,836 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock after selling 7,595 shares during the period. Apple makes up approximately 3.2% of Capital One National Association’s holdings, making the stock its 3rd largest holding. Capital One National Association’s holdings in Apple were worth $43,471,000 as of its most recent SEC filing.
Several other hedge funds also recently added to or reduced their stakes in AAPL. Rathbone Brothers plc grew its position in Apple by 6.5% during the 2nd quarter. Rathbone Brothers plc now owns 410,838 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock worth $76,050,000 after acquiring an additional 25,236 shares during the last quarter. TRUE Private Wealth Advisors grew its position in Apple by 6.6% during the 2nd quarter. TRUE Private Wealth Advisors now owns 47,352 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock worth $8,765,000 after acquiring an additional 2,943 shares during the last quarter. LGT Capital Partners LTD. grew its position in Apple by 7.3% during the 2nd quarter. LGT Capital Partners LTD. now owns 25,560 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock worth $4,731,000 after acquiring an additional 1,730 shares during the last quarter. Addenda Capital Inc. grew its position in Apple by 91.5% during the 2nd quarter. Addenda Capital Inc. now owns 155,634 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock worth $27,400,000 after acquiring an additional 74,349 shares during the last quarter. Finally, Hartwell J M Limited Partnership grew its position in Apple by 418.7% during the 2nd quarter. Hartwell J M Limited Partnership now owns 38,900 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock worth $7,201,000 after acquiring an additional 31,400 shares during the last quarter. Institutional investors own 58.58% of the company’s stock. Get Apple alerts:
AAPL stock opened at $224.29 on Friday. The company has a debt-to-equity ratio of 0.84, a quick ratio of 1.24 and a current ratio of 1.31. The firm has a market capitalization of $1,109.54 billion, a PE ratio of 24.35, a P/E/G ratio of 1.99 and a beta of 1.36. Apple Inc. has a twelve month low of $150.24 and a twelve month high of $233.47. Apple (NASDAQ:AAPL) last posted its quarterly earnings results on Tuesday, July 31st. The iPhone maker reported $2.34 earnings per share for the quarter, beating the Zacks’ consensus estimate of $2.18 by $0.16. The company had revenue of $53.27 billion for the quarter, compared to the consensus estimate of $52.43 billion. Apple had a return on equity of 43.50% and a net margin of 21.98%. The firm’s quarterly revenue was up 17.3% on a year-over-year basis. During the same quarter in the prior year, the business posted $1.67 EPS. On average, analysts expect that Apple Inc. will post 11.76 earnings per share for the current fiscal year.
In related news, CEO Timothy D. Cook sold 265,160 shares of the company’s stock in a transaction on Monday, August 27th. The shares were sold at an average price of $217.79, for a total value of $57,749,196.40. The transaction was disclosed in a legal filing with the Securities & Exchange Commission, which is available at this link . Also, SVP Angela J. Ahrendts sold 14,194 shares of the company’s stock in a transaction on Friday, October 5th. The shares were sold at an average price of $227.96, for a total transaction of $3,235,664.24. Following the completion of the sale, the senior vice president now owns 105,538 shares of the company’s stock, valued at approximately $24,058,442.48. The disclosure for this sale can be found here . In the last three months, insiders sold 579,837 shares of company stock worth $127,420,910. 0.06% of the stock is currently owned by company insiders.
A number of equities research analysts recently commented on the company. Atlantic Securities restated a “neutral” rating and set a $205.00 price target on shares of Apple in a research report on Wednesday, August 1st. BidaskClub lowered Apple from a “buy” rating to a “hold” rating in a research report on Wednesday, September 19th. BMO Capital Markets increased their price target on Apple from $184.00 to $199.00 and gave the stock a “market perform” rating in a research report on Wednesday, August 1st. They noted that the move was a valuation call. Cleveland Research restated a “buy” rating on shares of Apple in a research report on Wednesday, September 26th. Finally, Wells Fargo & Co set a $210.00 price target on Apple and gave the stock a “neutral” rating in a research report on Monday, October 1st. Two equities research analysts have rated the stock with a sell rating, nineteen have issued a hold rating and thirty have issued a buy rating to the company’s stock. The company presently has a consensus rating of “Buy” and a consensus price target of $220.78.
Apple Profile
Apple Inc designs, manufactures, and markets mobile communication and media devices, and personal computers to consumers, and small and mid-sized businesses; and education, enterprise, and government customers worldwide. The company also sells related software, services, accessories, networking solutions, and third-party digital content and applications.
